part_syntax: space-separated key:view tokens; view f=front b=back s=side_l; suffix (z) = zone fill; whole first

traits.knitwear: fully fashioned knitwear: gauge/structure checklist line, no seam-construction question
traits.cut_sew_knit: cut-and-sew jersey: knit seams line (514/516/607, coverstitch, bound edges)
traits.bottoms_fit: one-piece with legs: add the bottoms fit line (rise, seat, leg, length)
traits.skirt_volume: skirt or dress: add the volume line (gathers, pleats, godets, slit, lining)
traits.bra_fit: band and cup basis (size system, wired or soft)
